info.title: Troubleshooting at a Glance
info.subtitle: Simple checks to try before calling for repair

rows.title: No sound
rows.desc: Fresh battery, then a new wax guard

rows.title: Weak or muffled
rows.desc: Clear wax on the aid and in your ear

rows.title: Whistling
rows.desc: Reseat the fit; check for canal wax

rows.title: Short battery life
rows.desc: Dry the aids; streaming drains faster

rows.title: Won't connect
rows.desc: Forget the device, then re-pair the phone
